title: Verniman method: auction, order flow and execution knowledge base
summary: A source-backed method library covering 27 blog topics, plus local Daily Map calendar archives for 2014–2025 and January 1–October 30, 2026, with captured text/images and explicit source gaps, including recovered 2014–2016 archive sources and the partial 2017 source trail.
data_summary: Method review: 27 pages, 46 videos, 42 caption exports. Daily Maps: 2026 has 201 maps/198 dates plus two undated commentaries; 2025 has 246/242; 2024 has 251/247; 2023 has 248/245; 2022 has 158/157, May 16–December 30, plus separate older context; 2021 has 250/246 plus one malformed-date article; 2020 has 251/248 with 502 image references across 502 unique files, including one qualified 400-pixel inline chart; 2019 has 248/246 with 496 image references across 495 unique files; 2018 has 249/245 with 496 image references across 496 unique files and one text-only source article. 2017 has 28/28, November 20–December 29, plus twelve undated daily plans and 80 plan images; five educational context records remain raw outside daily counts. 2016 recovers 160 maps/160 dates, January 5–December 1, from 135 archived HTML sources and 25 exact Atom entries, with 560 current-source fallback images whose historical bytes are unverified. 2015 preserves 79 daily records: 65 dated maps/65 dates, March 26–December 31, plus fourteen undated Opening Print posts, with 246 qualified fallback images from 62 exact HTML sources and 17 exact Atom entries. Sixty-three context records remain raw outside daily counts. 2014 preserves 37 daily records: 35 dated plans/35 dates, June 3–November 25, plus two undated Opening Print posts, with 111 unique qualified fallback images from eleven archived HTML articles, one homepage post and twenty-five exact Atom entries in two original XML payloads. Fifty-two context revisions and five supporting daily revisions remain raw outside selected daily counts. All 4,686 scoped calendar dates recorded; no market-data calculations.
evidence_status: Qualitative source research and local source preservation. Annual snapshots retain gaps and duplicate dates. The 2022 early-year gap, source-year exceptions, malformed dates and image qualifications remain explicit. Near ATHs uses its independently reviewed 2021 date in that annual archive; completed earlier snapshots are unchanged. The 2018 December 24 article has no source images, and its publication/update claims do not replace anchored body dates. The 2017 trail has only 28 dated plans and twelve undated daily plans; navigation exhausts without a 2016 boundary, so historical completeness is not claimed. The 2016 archive recovery has 101 weekday and 105 weekend gaps, no observed 2015 boundary and no full historical-completeness claim; all 560 image responses retain unverified historical byte identity. The 2015 recovery has 196 weekday and 104 weekend gaps, fourteen unresolved daily-plan dates, no observed 2014 boundary and qualified historical-image uncertainty. Nine identical overlaps retain their raw supporting revisions; exact Older CDX checks were empty, while rate-limited availability probes remain unresolved. The 2014 recovery has 226 weekday and 104 weekend gaps, two unsupported Opening Print dates, no observed 2013 boundary and no historical full-year completeness claim; all 111 current-source images have unverified historical byte identity. Five daily overlaps retain raw supporting revisions, including two literal Update/Opening title changes. Eight image-only update or closing bodies remain raw context because they do not establish a morning plan. Exact observed Older/feed-next CDX and availability checks all returned successful empty results. No trading validation.
